notes.title: Unlockable, controller fix, physics update, background characters,
notes.content:
This is a BIG update for Flappy Butt. 

[list]
[*] Beat the game, and unlock a special option to enable hats...
[*] Hairless Flappy Butt background characters now flap their way in the background increasing the immersion in this Flappy Butt universe ten fold
[*] Controllers can now navigate to "Flap more" or "Quit" upon losing
[*] Physics on Flappy Butt character have been updated
[*] Added a safe check when resetting game data
[/list]
